description: Unit tests for InterfaceStateManagerImpl class, testing state reading, caching, event handling, and notification mechanisms.

methods.name: read_state_should_succeed_before_event
methods.description: Tests that the interface state can be read successfully before any state change event occurs.

methods.name: read_state_should_succeed_after_read
methods.description: Verifies that the state is cached after the first read and subsequent reads do not invoke the underlying read again.

methods.name: read_state_should_succeed_after_event
methods.description: Checks that the interface state is updated correctly after a state change event without explicit read.

methods.name: notify_state_changed_should_succeed
methods.description: Ensures that the notification callback is invoked correctly when the monitor reports a state change.
